cards.front: Attacking an EXCEPT or NOT question
cards.back: All but one option is in the passage. Locate and tick each option in turn. The one you cannot verify, or that the passage contradicts, is the answer. Verify the relationship, not the vocabulary.
Inference: what must be true from the text; prefer the modest option and distrust always, never and all. Application: write the passage’s rule in one sentence, then pick the new case that obeys it.
